applicability.description: The repository's automated test or validation surface repeatedly provisions deterministic repository, process, archive, container, service, or equivalent setup whose reuse can preserve the required evidence.

requirements.statement: Each retained real repository, process, service, or platform boundary supplies material evidence that cannot be proven faithfully at a lower production-owned contract or injected boundary.
Equivalent expensive deterministic setup is built once at the narrowest safe lifecycle scope and is reused through one stable owner, key, builder identity, and exact input digest.

Every mutable case receives a distinct isolated derivative or overlay; reset does not rebuild unchanged immutable input or share mutable repositories, refs, remotes, process state, credentials, mocks, or temporary roots.

Fixture ownership, lifecycle, builds, reuse, mutable derivatives, expensive boundary operations, cleanup, and approved count budgets are emitted or recorded in machine-readable repository-owned evidence.

Undeclared construction, conflicting identity, duplicate equivalent build, immutable baseline mutation, unsafe link or reparse state, cleanup leakage, and operation-count budget excess fail before authoritative test success.

An increased expensive-operation budget or broader fixture lifecycle scope requires explicit reviewed rationale linked to its owning work; elapsed time remains observational and does not replace count or behavior evidence.

conforming: Reviewed machine-readable evidence binds each expensive deterministic fixture to its owner, key, builder, lifecycle scope, exact input digest, build and reuse counts, mutable derivatives, fingerprints, cleanup, and approved operation budgets.

Executable negative coverage rejects undeclared or duplicate construction, identity conflict, immutable mutation, unsafe links, derivative leakage, cleanup leakage, and budget excess before authoritative success.
Focused and parent-runner evidence preserves active scenario ownership, supported runtimes, required real boundaries, separate suite isolation, and reviewed budget deltas.
notApplicable: Reviewed repository evidence proves that its automated test or validation surface does not repeatedly provision expensive deterministic setup or cross a retained real boundary covered by this capability.
The review identifies the inspected suites and boundaries and explains why adding fixture reuse or operation budgets would provide no material reliability or runner-consumption benefit.
